detailed_description: Document Formatter cleans pasted plain text with browser-side formatting options. You can trim line edges, remove extra spaces, remove blank lines, normalize line breaks, capitalize sentence starts, fix spacing before punctuation, wrap lines to a selected width, and add spaces or tabs as indentation. The formatted output updates beside the input and can be copied to the clipboard.
usage_steps: Paste text into the input area
Toggle whitespace, line break, capitalization, punctuation, wrapping, and indentation options
Review the formatted output beside the original text
Adjust options until the output looks right
usage_examples: Clean copied text with inconsistent spacing
Remove extra blank lines from notes
Wrap long plain-text paragraphs to a chosen line width
